summary.en: The robbery and arson group known as "Zorro" murdered three residents of the home they broke into and seriously injured a patrol officer. Yuji says he's out of the group after the leader shoots and kills three people living in the house. In response, the leader calls him a traitor, and decides to kill him. Conan and Yuji are cornered by the Zorro robbery group. The leader shoots an arrow at Yuji and he falls. In an attempt to save him, Conan reaches out and grabs Yuji's hand, only to be dragged off the cliff as well.
